# OBS007 `pause-statement`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A `pause` statement.

## Why

`pause` was deleted from the language in Fortran 95; compilers accept it only as an extension.

## Reported

```fortran
pause
```

## Preferred

```fortran
read(*, *)   ! or remove it
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OBS007] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OBS007` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `OB051` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
